name: Conscience Money
overview: The Scriptures reveal a profound connection between conscience and money, as seen in the account of Judas who, burdened by guilt for betraying innocent blood, returned the thirty pieces of silver before taking his own life (Matthew 27:3-5). Similarly, Judges 17:2 illustrates a candid acknowledgment of money taken wrongfully and the blessing pronounced upon the one who admits the truth. These passages highlight how conscience confronts the moral implications of handling money, especially when it involves wrongdoing or betrayal.
